title: Add Filter Button from Version 89 to ProductGrid

requirements.summary: Add a Filter button to the ProductGrid component that matches the design and functionality from Version 89
acceptanceCriteria: Filter button is visible in the ProductGrid component
Button design and placement matches Version 89 implementation
Button functionality works as it did in Version 89

file_operations.description: Add a Filter button to the ProductGrid component UI that matches Version 89 design. Place the button in the controls section alongside the existing sort and category controls. The button should toggle filter panel visibility and maintain consistency with the existing UI styling (gold-500 theme colors). Wire the button's onClick handler to toggle filter panel state.
